write_orca_input_files: write ORCA input files for a given ASE Atoms object with specified charge, multiplicity, and NBO settings
estimate_orca_memory: estimate the memory requirement in MB for an ORCA job based on the number of basis functions
count_basis_functions: count the total number of def2-TZVPD basis functions for a given set of atoms
generate_symmetry_break_block: generate an ORCA SCF rotate block to break symmetry in open-shell singlet calculations
configure_optimization_parameters: configure geometry optimization parameters using Sella or LBFGS optimizer with loose, standard, tight, or eval settings
